• 持续时间内，你能够感知到你周围30尺范围内的传送门，且不论那些传送门是否开启。
• 如果你以此侦测到了传送门，你可以再用一个动作对其进行分析。为此，你需要用施法属性进行一次DC15的属性检定。检定成功时，你将会得知这个传送门背后的目的地是哪个位面，以及他需要什么样的传送门钥匙，那之后本法术结束。检定失败时，你将不会得知该传送门的任何情报，且直到你下次施展本法术前你都无法再次对其分析。
• 本法术的侦测能力可以穿透大部分的障碍，但3尺厚的土木、1尺厚的岩石、1寸厚的常见金属、或薄薄一层铅都能阻挡本法术的侦测。
target:
• For the duration, you can sense portals within 30 feet of you, whether or not they are open.
• If you detect a portal in this way, you can use an action to analyze it. Make a DC 15 ability check using your spellcasting ability. On a success, you learn the plane of existence to which the portal leads and what kind of portal key it requires, after which the spell ends. On a failure, you learn nothing about the portal and cannot analyze it again until you cast this spell again.
• The spell's detection can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 3 feet of earth or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 cun of common metal, or a thin sheet of lead.
note: Preserved success ending the spell, failed-analysis lockout until recast, and all four barriers. Bare cun is retained for metal thickness pending unit verification.

source:
• 你给予你自己或施法距离内你可见的一个自愿生物以潜藏的幸运。在法术结束之前，当被选中的生物进行一次攻击检定，属性检定或者豁免检定时，他能够使该法术结束并扔一颗额外的D20骰，并决定使用哪一颗D20。或者，当这个生物成为一个攻击检定的目标时，他能够使该法术结束并扔一颗额外的D20骰，并决定使用哪一颗D20:攻击者所掷骰的或通过该法术所掷骰。
• 若原D20骰有优势或劣势，那么通过该法术掷出的D20在原D20的优势或劣势生效后生效。
• 升环施法效应：使用3环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比2环高一环的法术位可以令你指定一个额外的生物。
target:
• You grant hidden good fortune to yourself or a willing creature you can see within range. Before the spell ends, when the chosen creature makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, it can end the spell to roll an additional d20 and choose which d20 to use. Alternatively, when an attack roll targets the creature, it can end the spell to roll an additional d20 and choose which d20 is used: the attacker's roll or the roll from this spell.
• If the original d20 has Advantage or Disadvantage, the d20 from this spell is applied after resolving Advantage or Disadvantage on the original d20.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 3 or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2.
note: Preserved both own-roll and incoming-attack uses, spell expenditure, and applying the extra die after original Advantage/Disadvantage.

source:
• 你触摸一个至多不超过10磅的物件，使其魔法般地固定住。你与你施法时指定的生物能够如常移动它。你也可以设置一串密码，当密码在该物件5尺内被念出时，使该法术暂时被压制1分钟。
• 若该物件被固定在空中，那么它可以至多承载4000磅的重量。更重的负载会使其坠落。另外，一个生物能以其动作进行一个对抗你的法术豁免DC的力量检定。若其成功，则该物件能被他移动10尺。
• 升环施法效应：若你使用4环或5环法术位施展该法术，使该物件移动的检定DC增加5，并且它能够承载8000磅重的负载并持续24小时。如果你用6环或者更高环的法术位施展该法术，那么使该物件移动的检定DC增加10，并且它能够承载20000磅重的负载并一直持续到法术被解除。
target:
• You touch an object weighing no more than 10 pounds and magically fix it in place. You and creatures you designate when casting can move it normally. You can also set a password; speaking it within 5 feet of the object suppresses the spell for 1 minute.
• If fixed in the air, the object can support up to 4000 pounds. A greater load causes it to fall. In addition, a creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, that creature can move the object 10 feet.
• At Higher Levels: If you cast the spell using a level 4 or 5 slot, the DC to move the object increases by 5, its supported load becomes 8000 pounds, and its duration becomes 24 hours. If you use a slot of level 6 or higher, the DC to move it increases by 10, its supported load becomes 20000 pounds, and it lasts until dispelled.
note: Preserved normal access/password alternatives, overload falling, the action check, and both complete higher-level DC/load/duration bands.

source:
• 你轻弹手腕, 让你手中的一件物品消失。这件只有你能持握的，重量不超过五磅物件会被传送到一个异次元空间，它会在法术持续时间内一直停留在那里。
• 直到法术结束为止, 你可以用你的动作将物件召唤到你空余的手中, 你也可以用一个动作将该物件返还至异次元空间处。 到法术结束时仍然存在在异次元空间的物品会出现在你的位置中，你的脚下。
target:
• You flick your wrist and make an item in your hand disappear. The object, which only you can hold and which weighs no more than five pounds, is transported to an extradimensional space, where it remains for the duration.
• Until the spell ends, you can use your action to summon the object into a free hand, and you can use an action to return it to the extradimensional space. Any item still in that space when the spell ends appears at your position, at your feet.
note: The source's unusual phrase only you can hold is retained literally; whether it means exclusive capability or sole possession is unresolved. Retrieval and return each require an action.

source:
你创造出一股恐怖的力量，缓慢地从内部挤压目标。选择施法距离内一可见生物，掷2d6并记录掷出的总值。在你之后的每个回合开始时，再掷一次2d6并将掷出的数值加到总值上。

-若总值大于目标的力量，则其基于力量的攻击检定具有劣势。
-若总值大于目标的敏捷，则其速度减半，且针对它的攻击检定具有优势。
-若总值大于目标的当前生命值，则目标会立即向内坍缩并死亡。
context: column:M;spell:Clutch of Darkness;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:2
target:
You create a dreadful force that slowly crushes the target from within. Choose a creature you can see within range, roll 2d6, and record the total. At the start of each of your subsequent turns, roll 2d6 again and add the result to the running total.

- If the total exceeds the target's Strength, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls.
- If the total exceeds the target's Dexterity, its Speed is halved and attack rolls against it have Advantage.
- If the total exceeds the target's current Hit Points, the target immediately implodes and dies.
note: Preserved cumulative rolls, strict greater-than thresholds, each distinct effect, and comparison with current Hit Points. The source gives no saving throw or extra end condition in this body.

source:
你获得猫一样的灵巧反应力和平衡力。你获得以下增益直至法术结束：

-只要你未陷入失能，你免疫倒地
-当你坠落时，你能够以反应减少一定坠落伤害，数值等于你等级的五倍
-你的敏捷检定和敏捷豁免获得优势
-你的跳跃距离翻倍
context: column:M;spell:Feline Grace;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:2
target:
You gain a cat's agile reflexes and balance. You gain the following benefits until the spell ends:

- While you are not Incapacitated, you are immune to the Prone condition.
- When you fall, you can use a Reaction to reduce the falling damage by an amount equal to five times your level.
- You have Advantage on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws.
- Your jumping distance is doubled.
note: Preserved all four benefits, the Incapacitated exception, Reaction cost, and level-based damage reduction.

source:
你用一团毒素淤泥在法术持续时间内覆盖一片15尺宽的立方区域。该区域变为困难地形，并充满危险的毒气。一个进入该区域或在其中开始回合的生物必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则该生物受到1d8点毒素伤害并直到它的下一个回合开始前陷入中毒状态。即使生物不用呼吸或屏住呼吸，依然会受到此法术影响。
升环施法效应：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，法术的伤害就额外提升1d8。
target:
You cover a Cube 15 feet wide in toxic sludge for the duration. The area becomes Difficult Terrain and is filled with hazardous fumes. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. The spell affects creatures even if they do not need to breathe or are holding their breath.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved entry/start triggers without adding a once-per-turn limit, failed-save damage and Poisoned, and the breath-independent effect.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你的手掌分泌出粘稠的灼烧性强酸，你可以用它将一个生物攥握在痛苦之中。当你施展这个法术时，作为你的回合内法术结束前的动作的一部分，你可以对你身边5尺范围内的一个生物发动一次近战法术攻击。若攻击命中，你对目标造成4d4点强酸伤害，并且目标因为你的酸性抓取陷入束缚状态，直到你的下一个回合结束。你可以接下来逐轮攻击同一个目标，也可以在任何时间点改为攻击一个新的目标。如果你切换了目标，则前一个目标将不再受此法术影响。
一个因为你的抓握陷入束缚的生物可以用它的动作进行一次力量检定，以对抗你的施法豁免DC，若检定成功则其不再受到束缚。每当一个生物以被此法术造成的束缚状态结束它的回合，它就需要额外承受4d4点强酸伤害。
升环施法效应：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，法术的伤害就额外提升2d4。
target:
For the duration, your palms secrete thick, burning acid that you can use to clutch a creature in agony. When you cast this spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you as part of an action on your turn before the spell ends. On a hit, you deal 4d4 Acid damage to the target, and your acidic grip Restrains it until the end of your next turn. You can continue attacking the same target round after round, or switch to attacking a new target at any time. If you switch targets, the previous target is no longer affected by the spell.
A creature Restrained by your grip can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, ending the restraint on a success. Whenever a creature ends its turn Restrained by this spell, it takes an additional 4d4 Acid damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the spell's damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above level two.
note: The source's casting/action sentence is awkward; its action-on-your-turn wording and later permission to attack each round or switch targets are retained without adding a reaction or action-economy exception. Damage scaling is not assigned to only one component.

source:
一大群漂浮的幽灵手出现，并抓向范围内你能看见的一个目标。目标需要成功通过一次力量豁免。若豁免检定失败，则目标需要承受3d8点黯蚀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
除此之外，若豁免检定失败，幽灵手会擒抱目标直到你的下一个回合结束，并立即将目标向你所选择的方向移动30尺（但不能向上）。在目标的回合内，其可以进行一次力量检定或敏捷检定（由目标选择）来对抗你的法术豁免DC以逃脱擒抱。若成功，则擒抱结束。
升环施法效应：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，擒拿鬼手便可以额外多选择一个生物为目标。
target:
A host of floating ghostly hands appears and reaches for a target you can see within range. The target must make a Strength saving throw, taking 3d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
On a failed save, the ghostly hands also Grapple the target until the end of your next turn and immediately move it 30 feet in a direction you choose, but not upward. On its turn, the target can make a Strength or Dexterity check of its choice against your spell save DC to escape the Grapple. On a success, the Grapple ends.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, Grasping Ghost can target one additional creature for each slot level above level two.
note: Kept Grapple and forced movement explicitly within the failed-save branch. The source gives no action cost for the escape check, so none was added.

source:
你对范围内你能看见的一个生物发动一次远程法术攻击。如果命中，你用一种致命毒素对目标造成伤害，并使其眼睛开始流血。该生物将承受2d6点黯蚀伤害，并直到你的下一个回合结束前陷入目盲状态。
升环施法效应：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，黯蚀伤害就增加1d6点。
target:
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, you harm it with a deadly toxin and cause its eyes to bleed. The creature takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and is Blinded until the end of your next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the Necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved Necrotic damage despite the toxin description and the caster-next-turn blindness duration.

source: 一股力场波动从你张开的手中爆发，将施法距离内你一个你可见的生物抛出窗外。目标进行一次力量豁免检定。豁免失败则目标被推离至多20尺，并从你指定的一扇窗户被抛出。如果目标20尺范围内没有窗户，它会被改为向你选择的一个方向推离至多20尺，并从一个奥术力场构成的窗户被抛出，该窗户会在生物身后实体化并在碎裂后消失。目标被抛出窗户时会受到4d6挥砍伤害并陷入倒地状态。豁免成功则目标仅被推离10尺，且不受伤害。
target: A pulse of force bursts from your open hand to hurl a creature you can see within range out of a window. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed up to 20 feet and thrown through a window you choose. If there is no window within 20 feet of the target, it is instead pushed up to 20 feet in a direction you choose and thrown through a window of arcane force that materializes behind it, shatters, and vanishes. When thrown through the window, the target takes 4d6 Slashing damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, the target is pushed only 10 feet and takes no damage.
note: Preserved the real-window and conjured-window alternatives, target-centered window search, failed-save damage/Prone, and successful-save push without damage.

source:
你散发出一道醉酒灵光，这股灵光迅速消退，只余留强烈的宿醉感。施法距离内的一名你选择的生物进行一次体质豁免检定。豁免失败则该生物受到3d8心灵伤害，并陷入中毒状态直至你的下个回合结束。豁免成功则目标仅受半伤。目标因为此伤害而为维持专注所进行的体质豁免具有劣势。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d8。
target:
You emanate an aura of intoxication that quickly fades, leaving an intense hangover. A creature of your choice within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d8 Psychic damage and is Poisoned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half damage. The target has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration because of this damage.
At Higher Levels. The spell's damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved failed-save-only Poisoned while leaving the damage-caused Concentration penalty outside that branch, as written.

source:
附魔你触碰的那把远程武器，令它能够自动为自己换弹reload*。如果武器具有装填词条或换弹词条，法术持续时间内你将无视它们。当这把武器的弹药被击发后，新的弹药会从你的携带物品中自动传送到武器中。
译注：只能换弹reload，不能帮你上膛load
context: column:M;spell:Jethro’s Instant Reload;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:2
target:
You enchant the ranged weapon you touch so that it can reload* itself automatically. If it has the Loading or Reload property, you ignore those properties for the duration. After ammunition is fired from the weapon, new ammunition automatically teleports into it from your carried belongings.
Translator's note in the source: This can only reload; it cannot load or chamber a round for you.
note: Preserved both the main text's Loading/Reload claim and its apparently conflicting translator note that it cannot load. The contradiction is disclosed instead of silently reconciled.

source: 当你施展此法术时，记录你的位置。直至你的下一回合结束，你可以执行反应来传送回该位置，以响应一次攻击检定、一个生物施展一道法术，或一个生物移动至你5尺范围内；如果该位置被占据，则传送到最近的未占据空间。此传送先于触发的攻击或法术发生。法术随后结束。
target: When you cast this spell, record your position. Until the end of your next turn, you can use a Reaction to teleport back to that position in response to an attack roll, a creature casting a spell, or a creature moving within 5 feet of you. If the recorded position is occupied, you teleport to the nearest unoccupied space instead. The teleport occurs before the triggering attack or spell. The spell then ends.
note: Preserved all three triggers, occupancy fallback, and explicit priority before an attack/spell without inventing a separate movement-priority rule.

source:
你和施法距离内最多三名你选择的自愿生物之间形成奥术连结，这种连结会在彼此靠近时产生魔法牵引。在法术持续时间内，每个目标的速度增加5尺。当任何一个受影响的生物结束其回合时，该法术的其他目标可以使用反应移动最多等于其速度一半的距离，朝向另一个受影响的生物移动。
升环施法。使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，你可以额外选择一个目标。
context: column:M;spell:At Your Side;book:胧忆岛：蒿野物语;level:2
target:
Arcane bonds form between you and up to three willing creatures of your choice within range, exerting a magical pull when you are near one another. For the duration, each target's Speed increases by 5 feet. When any affected creature ends its turn, the spell's other targets can use a Reaction to move up to half their Speed toward another affected creature.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can choose one additional target for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the caster-plus-chosen-creatures link wording, end-of-turn trigger, Reaction movement limit, and direction toward an affected creature.

source:
这个法术可以将施法距离内你能看见的一只野兽变形为一个类人生物的形态。非自愿的生物必须通过一次感知豁免检定才能避免此效应。该法术对生命值为0的野兽无效。
变形效应持续到法术终止，或直到目标生命值降至0或死亡为止。新的形态可以是任何你选择的种族的类人生物外观。目标的游戏资料，不包括其精神属性值，会被替换为一名平民的数据。它保留其原有的阵营和个性。
目标获得其平民形态的生命值。当它恢复原形时，野兽会恢复到其变形前的生命值。如果是因为生命值降至0而恢复原形，则多余的伤害会转移到其原形态上。只要这些多余的伤害不会让野兽原形态的生命值降至0，它就不会陷入昏迷。
生物能够执行的动作会受其新形态的性质限制。
升环施法。使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，法术持续时间增加1小时。
target:
This spell transforms a Beast you can see within range into a Humanoid form. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on a Beast with 0 Hit Points.
The transformation lasts until the spell ends, the target drops to 0 Hit Points, or it dies. The new form can resemble a Humanoid of any species you choose. The target's game statistics, except its mental ability scores, are replaced by those of a Commoner. It retains its alignment and personality.
The target gains the Hit Points of its Commoner form. When it reverts, the Beast returns to the Hit Points it had before transforming. If it reverts because it dropped to 0 Hit Points, excess damage carries over to its original form. As long as that excess damage does not reduce the Beast's original form to 0 Hit Points, it does not become Unconscious.
The creature's available actions are limited by the nature of its new form.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the mental-score exception, all transformation endpoints, form HP and damage carryover, conditional avoidance of Unconscious, and duration-only scaling.

source:
选择施法距离内一只你能看见的野兽。若该野兽的挑战等级为2或更低，则会受到法术影响；否则法术失败。受影响的生物必须通过一次感知豁免，失败则你的意识进入其身体，你将完全且精确地控制它。在此法术效应下，你能通过该生物的眼睛视物，听到它所能听到的声音，并获得该生物所具有的任何特殊感官的好处。你可以如同该生物一般移动并采取动作，且可以执行该生物在能力范围内可以完成的任务。在此期间，你的身体处于昏迷状态；这不会影响你对此法术的专注。
若该生物受到伤害，你必须进行一次感知（驯兽）检定，其DC等于10或该生物受到伤害值的一半，取较高者。若检定失败，该生物重获对其身体的控制权，且法术终止。
升环施法。使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，该法术能影响的最大挑战等级提高1。
target:
Choose a Beast you can see within range. The spell can affect it if its Challenge Rating is 2 or lower; otherwise, the spell fails. The affected creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, your consciousness enters its body and you control it completely and precisely. While under this spell's effect, you see through its eyes, hear what it hears, and benefit from any special senses it possesses. You can move and take actions as the creature and perform tasks within its capabilities. During this time, your own body is Unconscious; this does not affect your Concentration on the spell.
If the creature takes damage, you must make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check with a DC equal to 10 or half the damage it took, whichever is higher. On a failed check, it regains control of its body and the spell ends.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the maximum Challenge Rating the spell can affect increases by 1 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved CR eligibility, possession only on a failed save, Unconscious without losing Concentration, and a damage-triggered Animal Handling check rather than a Constitution save.

source: 你在施法距离内的地面上一点为中心，用蜡烛和沙子创造出一个复杂的奥术法阵。该法阵可以有10尺或更小的半径。在法术结束前的任何时候，如果法阵外的生物通过魔法或非魔法手段看见或听见你，蜡烛的火焰会改变颜色。如果是法术或魔法效应在起作用，你会察觉到它并理解其效应的范围。
target: You use candles and sand to create an intricate arcane circle centered on a point on the ground within range. The circle can have a radius of 10 feet or less. At any time before the spell ends, if a creature outside the circle sees or hears you by magical or nonmagical means, the candle flames change color. If a spell or magical effect is involved, you sense it and understand the scope of its effect.
note: Preserved detection of either magical or mundane observation and the extra information only when magic is involved.

source:
你吞下施法时消耗的油。在法术结束前，你可以使用一个附赠动作呼出这些油，并在将其从体内喷出时点燃它。一条5尺宽、30尺长的直线范围内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败时受到2d10点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
一旦你呼出油，法术随即结束。
target:
You swallow the oil consumed in casting. Before the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to breathe the oil out, igniting it as it leaves your body. Each creature in a Line 5 feet wide and 30 feet long must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Once you breathe out the oil, the spell ends.
note: Preserved consumed oil, deferred single Bonus Action breath, exact Line dimensions, save outcomes, and immediate spell ending after use.

source:
你召唤出一只巨大的虚体猿掌，它升起并试图抓住施法距离内你能看见的一个巨型或更小的地面生物。猿掌尝试擒抱目标，使用你的施法关键属性调整值进行擒抱检定。如果你在对抗中失败，猿掌消失，法术终止。
被猿掌擒抱的目标在其每回合开始时受到1d8点暗蚀伤害。目标可以用其动作按正常规则尝试挣脱擒抱。当擒抱被解除时，猿掌消失，法术终止。
升环施法。使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，就可以额外选择一个目标，并为每个目标分别召唤一只猿掌。这种情况下，法术持续到最后一只猿掌消失为止。当你选择这些目标时，它们之间的距离必须在60尺以内。
target:
You summon a gigantic spectral ape hand that rises and tries to seize a Huge or smaller creature on the ground that you can see within range. The hand attempts to Grapple the target, using your spellcasting ability modifier for the Grapple check. If you lose the contest, the hand disappears and the spell ends.
A target Grappled by the hand takes 1d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. It can use its action to try to escape the Grapple normally. When the Grapple ends, the hand disappears and the spell ends.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can choose one additional target for each slot level above level two, summoning a separate hand for each. In this case, the spell lasts until the last hand disappears. The targets must be within 60 feet of one another when you choose them.
note: Preserved the source's contested Grapple using only the stated spellcasting modifier, ground/size restrictions, and multi-hand last-disappearance rule; no 2024 Grapple save substitution.

source:
你触碰一到三发弹药，将独特的蘑菇魔法注入其中，使其在弹药上或弹药尖端长出肥厚的绿色蘑菇。
当生物被使用该弹药的远程武器攻击命中时，它额外受到1d6点毒素伤害，且必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败时，该生物被推离等同于所受伤害数值的距离（向上取整到最近的5尺），最多15尺。无论攻击是否命中，法术随即在该发弹药上终止。
如果你再次施展这个法术，先前施法影响的任何弹药上的法术效果随即终止。
target:
You touch one to three pieces of ammunition and infuse them with unusual mushroom magic, causing plump green mushrooms to grow on them or their tips.
When a creature is hit by a ranged weapon attack using this ammunition, it takes an extra 1d6 Poison damage and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed a distance equal to the damage it took, rounded up to the nearest 5 feet, to a maximum of 15 feet. Whether the attack hits or misses, the spell then ends on that piece of ammunition.
If you cast this spell again, its effects end immediately on any ammunition affected by your previous casting.
note: Preserved the damage-based push and rounding/cap. The source does not clarify whether damage means all hit damage or only the extra Poison damage; the target retains that wording.

source:
你迅速跺脚，召唤出一根木质或石质的柱体，从你脚下向施法距离内你能看见的一个生物突进。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标受到2d12点钝击伤害，且如果目标是巨型或更小体型，它会被推离你10尺远。你与目标之间的直线地面变成困难地形，每个5尺方格区域若要用手清理至少需要1分钟。
升环施法。使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，伤害就增加1d12。
context: column:M;spell:Pillar of Force;book:胧忆岛：蒿野物语;level:2
target:
You stamp your foot and summon a pillar of wood or stone that surges from beneath you toward a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 2d12 Bludgeoning damage, and if it is Huge or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet away from you. The ground in a straight line between you and the target becomes Difficult Terrain. Clearing each 5-foot square by hand takes at least 1 minute.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the size-limited push within the hit branch and the separate ground-change sentence, without restricting that terrain effect to a hit.

source:
选择施法距离内的一个生物，可以是你自己。一朵洁白蓬松的云朵出现在目标上方，并在法术持续时间内跟随目标移动。当目标受到来自你能看见的敌对生物的伤害时，你可以使用反应，从云朵中对该生物发动一次远程法术攻击，前提是该生物位于目标60尺范围内。若命中，该生物受到2d8点闪电伤害。
升环施法。当你使用三环或更高法术位施放该法术时，每比二环高两环，伤害额外增加1d8。
target:
Choose a creature within range, which can be yourself. A fluffy white cloud appears above the target and follows it for the duration. When the target takes damage from a hostile creature you can see, you can use a Reaction to make a ranged spell attack from the cloud against that creature, provided it is within 60 feet of the target. On a hit, the creature takes 2d8 Lightning damage.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above level two.
note: Preserved the hostile-visible-damager trigger, range measured from the protected target, and two-level scaling interval.

source:
当你施展此法术时，你能提取出所有魔法中蕴含的独特气息。选择施法距离内你能察觉到的一个魔法效应。该效应会释放出其创造者特有的气息。如果你熟悉该生物，你会自动知道这个魔法效应是由它创造的。
如果你不熟悉该生物，你可以进行一次使用你的施法关键属性调整值的属性检定，并加上你的熟练加值。参考下表确定你从气息中能获得什么信息。当你在某个DC的检定中成功时，你也会获得较低DC对应的信息。
DC 5。你得知创造该魔法效应的生物类型。
DC 10。如果该生物具有职业，你得知其职业。
DC 15。你得知该生物是否隶属于某个组织。
DC 20。你得知该生物的名字。
target:
When you cast this spell, you draw out the distinctive traces contained in all magic. Choose a magical effect you can perceive within range. It releases a trace unique to its creator. If you are familiar with that creature, you automatically know that it created the effect.
If you are not familiar with the creature, you can make an ability check using your spellcasting ability modifier and adding your Proficiency Bonus. Consult the table below to determine what you learn from the trace. Succeeding at a given DC also grants the information for lower DCs.
DC 5. You learn the creature type of the effect's creator.
DC 10. If the creature has a class, you learn its class.
DC 15. You learn whether the creature belongs to an organization.
DC 20. You learn the creature's name.
note: Preserved automatic identification of a familiar creator, caster-ability-plus-proficiency check, cumulative thresholds, and all four information rows.

source:
你指定施法距离内一个你熟悉的自愿生物作为目标。在法术持续时间内，或直到目标以一个动作主动解除效果之前，目标可以通过你的双眼观察，并获得你所拥有的任何特殊感官的好处。在此期间，目标可以用一个附赠动作在使用自己的视觉和你的视觉之间切换。
升环施法。当你使用3环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环可以额外指定一个自愿生物作为目标。
target:
Choose a willing creature familiar to you within range. For the duration, or until the target uses an action to end the effect, it can see through your eyes and benefit from any special senses you have. During that time, the target can use a Bonus Action to switch between its own vision and yours.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 3 or higher, you can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the direction of shared vision from caster to target, familiarity, target-controlled action dismissal, and Bonus Action switching.

source:
此法术允许你改变施法距离内你能看到的两个类人生物的外貌。每个目标都获得幻术伪装，使其看起来像另一个目标——包括其盔甲、衣物、武器和其他随身物品。每个生物可以显得比实际高或矮1尺；除此之外，伪装会尽可能准确地复制另一个目标的体貌特征。除非你用动作提前解除，否则法术会持续到时间结束。
此法术造成的改变无法经受物理接触的检验。例如，如果此法术使一个生物因伪装而获得一件斗篷，物体会穿过这件斗篷，任何触摸斗篷的人都不会感到触感，或者会触摸到生物的背部或肩膀。如果此法术使一个生物显得比实际更小，当有人伸手触摸该生物时，他的手看似还在半空中时就会碰到实体。
生物可以使用动作检查一个目标，并进行一次对抗你法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定。若成功，它会意识到目标是在伪装。
target:
This spell lets you change the appearance of two Humanoids you can see within range. Each gains an illusory disguise that makes it look like the other, including armor, clothing, weapons, and other carried belongings. Each creature can appear up to 1 foot taller or shorter than it really is; otherwise, the disguise copies the other's physical features as closely as possible. The spell lasts for the duration unless you use an action to end it early.
The changes do not withstand physical inspection. For example, if the disguise gives a creature a cloak, objects pass through the cloak, and someone touching it feels nothing or touches the creature's back or shoulders instead. If the disguise makes a creature appear smaller, a hand reaching for it touches its real body while the hand still seems to be in midair.
A creature can use an action to examine a target and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it realizes the target is disguised.
note: Preserved both complete physical-inspection examples, reciprocal disguises, height limit, and separate caster-dismissal and observer-examination actions.

source: 你暂时性地转为隐形以避免被触发该法术的生物发现。直到你下一回合结束前，你始终处于隐形状态，且无论你在什么表面上移动，你的脚步都不会发出任何声响。任何你穿戴或携带的物品只要还在你身上就同样处于隐形状态。如果你发动攻击或施展法术，则该法术提前终止。
target: You briefly become Invisible to avoid being noticed by the creature that triggered this spell. You remain Invisible until the end of your next turn, and your footsteps make no sound regardless of the surface you move across. Anything you wear or carry is also Invisible while it remains on you. The spell ends early if you attack or cast a spell.
note: Preserved general invisibility rather than observer-only invisibility, silent footsteps on any surface, carried-item condition, and early-ending actions.

source:
你牺牲一部分生命力以增强你的魔法力量。当你施展该法术时，你受到1d6暗蚀伤害，此伤害无法以任何方式减少或阻止。在持续时间内，当你施展一道造成伤害的法术时，该法术的一个目标（由你选择）会额外受到1d6伤害，伤害类型与法术正常的伤害类型相同（如果有多种伤害类型，由你选择）。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你受到的伤害以及你法术造成的额外伤害均增加1d6。
target:
You sacrifice some of your life force to strengthen your magic. When you cast this spell, you take 1d6 Necrotic damage that cannot be reduced or prevented in any way. For the duration, whenever you cast a spell that deals damage, one target of that spell of your choice takes an extra 1d6 damage of the spell's normal damage type. If the spell has multiple damage types, you choose which one.
At Higher Levels. The damage you take and the extra damage your spells deal each increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved unavoidable caster damage, one chosen target per damaging spell, damage-type choice, and scaling of both costs and benefits.

source:
你向施法距离内一个你可见的生物掷出一条带有倒刺的虚幻锁链。目标进行一次力量豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到2d6力场伤害，被拉向你至多30尺，并被锁链捆缚。被锁链捆缚期间，该生物被拴系于你，无法移动或传送至距离你超过30尺的空间，并且你对该生物进行的攻击检定具有优势。 
若豁免成功，则目标仅受半伤。被捆缚的目标在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。若你与目标之间的距离超过30尺，则该法术终止。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You throw a barbed, illusory chain at a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 Force damage, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is bound by the chain. While bound, it is tethered to you and cannot move or teleport to a space more than 30 feet from you, and your attack rolls against it have Advantage.
On a successful save, the target takes only half damage. A bound target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. The spell ends if the distance between you and the target exceeds 30 feet.
At Higher Levels. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved failed-save-only pull/binding, movement and teleport tether, caster-specific Advantage, and distance ending regardless of which creature changes position. Binding is not relabeled as Restrained.

source:
你在施法距离内一处你可见的点召唤出失落灵魂的诡异歌声与悲号。以该点为源点的15尺球状区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到2d6心灵伤害，并在持续时间内陷入恐慌状态。若豁免成功，则其受到半伤，并陷入恐慌状态，直至其下一回合结束。被恐慌的目标在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Chorus of the Lost;book:歪曲之月;level:2
target:
You summon eerie singing and wailing from lost souls at a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 15-foot Sphere originating from that point must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 Psychic damage and is Frightened for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn. A Frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved Frightened even on a successful save, with its shorter duration. The source calls the area a 15-foot Sphere without explicitly labeling radius or diameter; that wording remains.

source:
你对施法距离内一个你可见的生物施加一首侵蚀心智的歌谣。如果该生物的智力为4或更高，则其必须进行一次智力豁免检定，豁免失败则其在持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。 
以这种方式被魅惑期间，目标会被一首只有它能听见的、快速重复的民谣所折磨；它在其每个回合开始时受到1d6心灵伤害，并在感知（察觉）检定以及用于维持专注的体质豁免中具有劣势。目标在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则终止自身该法术。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You inflict a mind-eroding ballad on a creature you can see within range. If the creature has an Intelligence of 4 or higher, it must make an Intelligence saving throw or be Charmed for the duration.
While Charmed in this way, the target is tormented by a rapidly repeating folk song that only it can hear. It takes 1d6 Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns and has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the Intelligence threshold and confinement of damage/check penalties to being Charmed this way, plus start/end-of-turn timing.

source:
你通过鲜血的力量获知施法距离内一个你可见生物的信息。你得知目标的种族、生物类型、当前生命值以及所有正在影响它的状态。你还会得知它是否具有以下任何内容，如果有，具体是什么：抗性，易伤，或对伤害或状态的免疫。 
此外，你在你的下一回合结束前对目标进行的下一次属性检定或攻击检定具有优势。
target:
Through the power of blood, you learn information about a creature you can see within range. You learn the target's species, creature type, current Hit Points, and every condition currently affecting it. You also learn whether it has any Resistances, Vulnerabilities, or Immunities to damage or conditions, and exactly what they are if present.
In addition, you have Advantage on the next ability check or attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn.
note: Preserved all information categories, current rather than maximum Hit Points, and the one-use choice of check or attack before the deadline.

source:
你在15尺锥状区域内释放出一道光与风的冲击。锥状区域内你的盟友会恢复2d6生命值。锥状区域内对你敌对的亡灵必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则受到2d6光耀伤害，豁免成功则受到半伤。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，伤害与治疗量就均增加1d6。
target:
You release a blast of light and wind in a 15-foot Cone. Your allies in the Cone regain 2d6 Hit Points. Undead in the Cone that are hostile to you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels. Both damage and healing increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved independent ally healing and hostile-Undead damage, without damaging other enemies or excluding Undead allies from the stated healing.

source:
选择施法距离内一个你可见的生物，并向其低语一句只有它可听见的骇人短语。目标必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则目标受到2d6心灵伤害，并陷入恐慌状态，直至你的下一回合开始。若豁免成功，则目标仅受半伤。 
以这种方式被恐慌期间，该生物对你选择的钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害具有易伤。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你就可以多选择一个生物作为目标。
target:
Choose a creature you can see within range and whisper a horrifying phrase that only it can hear. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 Psychic damage and is Frightened until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes only half damage.
While Frightened in this way, the creature has Vulnerability to your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.
At Higher Levels. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved Vulnerability only while Frightened by this effect, the single chosen physical damage type, and target-count scaling rather than damage scaling.

source:
你与一名生物发起令人瞩目的决斗。若没有盟友位于你5尺内，选择施法距离内一名能看见并听见你的生物，该生物必须成功通过一次魅力豁免，否则将回应你的挑战并与你战斗。在法术持续时间内，你的AC具有+2加值，目标对除你之外任何生物发动攻击检定时都具有劣势，且目标首次尝试移动远离你时必须成功通过一次魅力豁免，否则其速度降为0。
你在距离该目标超过 30 尺的位置结束你的回合时，该法术终止。
target:
You challenge a creature to a conspicuous duel. If no ally is within 5 feet of you, choose a creature within range that can see and hear you. It must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or answer your challenge and fight you. For the duration, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and the first time it attempts to move away from you, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have its Speed reduced to 0.
The spell ends if you end your turn more than 30 feet from the target.
note: Preserved the no-nearby-ally targeting prerequisite, separate duration-benefit sentence, first-attempt movement save, and caster-end-of-turn distance condition. No duration for the zero Speed beyond the source wording was added.

source:
你触碰一件非魔法武器。直到法术结束前，下一个被该武器命中的生物必须通过一次体质豁免，否则会伤口溃烂。伤口溃烂的生物在其回合开始时受到2d6点暗蚀伤害，持续至法术结束。一个生物同时只能有一道这样的溃烂伤口。
接受至少1魔法治疗后，溃烂的伤口会愈合，结束重复伤害和法术。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，伤口溃烂的伤害增加1d6。
target:
You touch a nonmagical weapon. Before the spell ends, the next creature hit by that weapon must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or develop a festering wound. A creature with the wound takes 2d6 Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends. A creature can have only one such wound at a time.
Receiving at least 1 point of magical healing closes the wound, ending the recurring damage and the spell.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the wound's damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved next-hit-only application, one-wound limit, recurring timing, and removal by at least 1 magical healing; no nonmagical healing removal was added.

source:
你选择的一个目标必须进行一次感知豁免。若豁免失败，则你和目标之间会形成一条病态的绿色以太系链。每当你受到伤害时、每个被此链接的目标都会受到该伤害一半的暗蚀伤害。 以这种方式造成的伤害会在计算抗性或免疫后再应用。如果被系住的目标生命值数降为0，则其将不再受到此法术的影响。 以一个附赠动作，你可以将系链从一个倒下（此处指生命值为0或死亡）的敌人身上到另一个目标身上。新目标必须通过一次感知豁免，否则也会受到此法术的影响。一个目标只能有一条系链。
升环施法。当你用四环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每2比环高2环，便可增加一条系链。
target:
A target you choose must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a sickly green ethereal tether forms between you and the target. Whenever you take damage, each target linked in this way takes Necrotic damage equal to half that damage. Damage dealt this way is applied after Resistance or Immunity is accounted for. If a tethered target drops to 0 Hit Points, it is no longer affected by the spell. As a Bonus Action, you can move a tether from a fallen enemy, meaning one at 0 Hit Points or dead, to another target. The new target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or also be affected by the spell. A target can have only one tether.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level four or higher, you gain one additional tether for every 2 slot levels above 2.
note: The source's resistance/immunity sentence does not identify whose mitigation is meant; its sequencing is retained without resolving that ambiguity. The malformed scaling phrase is read as every 2 levels above 2, preserving both written numerals.

source:
你引导原始的掠食能量，完美地隐藏自己的存在，让你能够出其不意地攻击目标。法术持续期间你会保持隐形，并在所有敏捷（隐匿）检定上具有优势。隐形持续至法术持续时间结束，但当你期间移动超过施法时的位置5尺或更远就会提前结束。
只要保持隐形，对任何未察觉您的目标发动的第一次攻击额外造成1d6 点伤害。这次攻击会结束法术。
升环施法。当你使用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，第一次攻击的额外伤害就会增加 1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Ambush Prey;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:2
target:
You channel primal predatory energy to hide your presence perfectly and catch a target by surprise. For the duration, you are Invisible and have Advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The invisibility lasts for the duration but ends early if you move beyond 5 feet from the position where you cast the spell.
While you remain Invisible, your first attack against a target unaware of you deals an extra 1d6 damage. That attack ends the spell.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the first attack's extra damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level two.
note: The source redundantly mixes beyond 5 feet with or farther; the translation retains beyond, and the exact-boundary wording remains uncertain. The extra damage has no type specified in the source.

source:
当你站在河岸或其他水域的岸边时，你召唤一个摆渡灵魄和它的船，它会出现在施法距离内一处可见未占据空间里。当它的生命值降为0或法术结束时，灵魄就会消失。灵魄对你和你的同伴友好。你需为该生物投掷先攻，该生物有自己的回合。它能带你和本法术每环阶最多1名同伴穿过河流或水体（不需要你的任何动作）或沿着同一水域的其他地点。如果你不发出任何命令，它会保护自己免受敌对生物的攻击，否则不会采取任何动作。
如果你的专注被打破，渡船和摆渡人不会消失。相反，你失去了对被召唤的灵魄的控制，它变得对你和你的同伴充满敌意，它可能会攻击你。一个不受控制的摆渡人不能被你解散，在你召唤它1小时后就会消失。DM掌握摆渡灵魄的数据（使用次级月魔Lesser Lunar Devil ，见第九章（翻译暂缺），或须魔Bearded Devil 的数据）。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，船可以带你和你的同伴穿过一个位面边界进入以太位面，然后在另一处水体处离开（使用猬魔Barbed Devil的数据）。当你使用五环或更环阶的法术位施展此法术时，它可以穿越冥河River Styx，将你和你的同伴带到多元宇宙的远处（使用月魔Lunar Devil（见《万兽图志》）或骨魔Bone Devil 的数据）。
译注：月魔数据卡见后文引用怪物或万兽图志
target:
While standing on the bank of a river or the shore of another body of water, you summon a ferryman spirit and its boat in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends. It is friendly to you and your companions. Roll Initiative for the creature; it takes its own turns. It can carry you and up to 1 companion per spell level across the river or body of water, or to other places along the same water, requiring no action from you. If you give no commands, it defends itself against hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.
If your Concentration is broken, the boat and ferryman do not disappear. Instead, you lose control of the spirit, and it becomes hostile to you and your companions and might attack you. You cannot dismiss an uncontrolled ferryman, and it disappears 1 hour after you summoned it. The DM has the spirit's statistics; use those of a Lesser Lunar Devil, from chapter nine (the source notes that its translation is currently unavailable), or a Bearded Devil.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the boat can carry you and your companions across a planar boundary into the Ethereal Plane and emerge at another body of water; use the Barbed Devil stat block. When you cast it using a spell slot of level five or higher, it can travel along the River Styx to carry you and your companions to distant parts of the multiverse; use a Lunar Devil, from Tome of Beasts, or a Bone Devil.
Translator's note in the source: See the referenced monsters later in the text or Tome of Beasts for Lunar Devil stat blocks.
note: Preserved the full summoning/control-loss exception, one-hour timer measured from summoning, passenger scaling, both planar-travel tiers, all alternative stat blocks, and both source cross-reference/translation notes.

source: 你让目标的武器迅速腐蚀。你选择施法距离内一持用锻造的，非魔法武器的生物，其必须成功通过一次力量豁免。如果失败则目标所有武器伤害掷骰必须投掷两次取较低的结果，如果法术在1分钟内结束，目标的武器将恢复正常状态。否则，武器会分解变成一堆铁锈或木屑（视情况而定）。
target: You rapidly corrode the target's weapons. Choose a creature within range wielding a manufactured, nonmagical weapon. It must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it must roll all its weapon damage rolls twice and use the lower result. If the spell ends within 1 minute, its weapon returns to normal. Otherwise, the weapon crumbles into rust or wood chips, as appropriate.
note: Preserved the source's all-weapon-damage wording, manufactured nonmagical eligibility, and restoration-versus-destruction timing without narrowing the effect to a single damage roll.

source:
你哼着舒缓的旋律，丢下一点熊毛，它会诱导你触碰的下一个生物进入一种令人昏昏欲睡的治疗状态。目标恢复1d6点生命值，每恢复一点生命值就陷入10分钟的睡眠。如果该生物非自愿，则必须通过一次体质豁免，否则会在法术持续时间内陷入睡眠。 在其每个回合结束时，目标可以重复豁免。成功则目标身上的法术效应结束。
每个受此法术影响的生物都会陷入昏迷，直到法术结束、冬眠的生物受到伤害，或有人使用动作摇醒或拍醒冬眠的生物。 亡灵和免疫魅惑的生物不受此法术的影响。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比一环高环，便可额外触碰一个自愿生物作为冬眠术的目标。
target:
You hum a soothing melody and drop a bit of bear fur, inducing a drowsy healing state in the next creature you touch. The target regains 1d6 Hit Points and sleeps for 10 minutes for each Hit Point restored. If unwilling, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the spell's duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the save, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
Every creature affected by this spell is Unconscious until the spell ends, the hibernating creature takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. Undead and creatures immune to being Charmed are unaffected.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can touch one additional willing creature as a target of Hibernation for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved healing-linked sleep, repeated saves, awakening methods, and exclusions. The source's malformed scaling clause names level one despite this being a level-two spell and omits an explicit increment; translated as each level above one, with that ambiguity disclosed rather than corrected to level two.

source:
一条6英寸长的蛆虫在施法距离内你选择的生物体内，并开始从内部吞噬目标。你对施法距离内的一名目标发动一次近战法术攻击。命中后目标会受到1d8+你的施法属性调整值点暗蚀伤害。作为附赠动作项，在你随后的每个回合内你都可以这样重复攻击目标。
目标在其回合中可以以一个动作对蛆虫发动一次近战武器攻击。造成穿刺或挥砍伤害。蛆虫的护甲等级等于你的法术豁免DC，本法术的所用的法术位每环阶给予8点生命值。如果你的目标命中蛆，会对蛆虫造成一半的伤害，而目标受到另一半伤害。如果蛆被杀死，法术结束。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比环2高一环，造成的伤害增加1d8点。
target:
A maggot 6 inches long appears inside a creature you choose within range and begins eating it from within. Make a melee spell attack against a target within range. On a hit, it takes Necrotic damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. On each of your subsequent turns, you can use a Bonus Action to repeat this attack against the target.
On its turn, the target can use an action to make a melee weapon attack against the maggot, dealing Piercing or Slashing damage. The maggot's AC equals your spell save DC, and it has 8 Hit Points per level of the spell slot used. If the target hits the maggot, the maggot takes half the damage and the target takes the other half. If the maggot is killed, the spell ends.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2.
note: Preserved a melee spell attack at the stated spell range, target self-injury when attacking the maggot, AC/HP rules, and repeat Bonus Actions. The source explicitly uses inches; its reordered scaling words are rendered without changing the numeral 2.

source:
你用手指做出一个切割动作，魔法地进入将你擒抱或吞咽生物的身体，并从背面离开。你立即解除目标生物对你的擒抱，且该生物必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败受到3d12点暗蚀伤害，豁免成功伤害减半。
如果是在被吞咽的情况下施展该法术，不管你对它造成了多少伤害，你都会离开触发生物的身体。倒地并出现在触发反应的生物10尺内的一处未占据空间。
升环施法。当你使用三环或者更高环阶的法术位施展此法术时，每比二环高一环，造成的伤害增加1d12。
target:
You make a cutting gesture with your fingers, magically entering the body of the creature Grappling or swallowing you and passing out through its back. You immediately end that creature's Grapple on you, and it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d12 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
If you cast the spell while swallowed, you leave the triggering creature's body regardless of how much damage you deal. You appear Prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the creature that triggered the Reaction.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved immediate escape from Grapple, swallowed escape independent of damage, Prone exit position, and save-based damage.

source: 你用卡祖笛吹奏出悠长、婉转的音符。所有距离你10尺内能听到你的声音的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败的生物会在你的每个回合开始时受到1d6点雷鸣伤害，并在持续时间内无法施展具有语言成分的法术。豁免成功的生物会受到1d6点雷鸣伤害，并在其下一回合结束前无法施展带有语言成分的法术。豁免失败的生物可以在其每个回合结束时重新豁免，豁免成功终止对自身影响。
target: You play long, lilting notes on a kazoo. Every creature within 10 feet of you that can hear you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 Thunder damage at the start of each of your turns and cannot cast spells with a Verbal component for the duration. On a successful save, it takes 1d6 Thunder damage and cannot cast spells with a Verbal component until the end of its next turn. A creature that failed the save can repeat it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
note: Preserved the successful-save damage and brief casting prohibition, failed-save recurring damage on the caster's turns, and repeat saves only for failed targets.

source:
你指定施法距离内至多三个名可见生物，并迫使其进行一次魅力豁免。豁免失败者直至法术结束前，其每当进行攻击检定或豁免时，必须从掷骰结果中减去一个d12。
升环施法。使用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展本法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，就能多指定一个目标。
target:
Choose up to three creatures you can see within range and force each to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, until the spell ends, the creature must subtract a d12 from the result whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved d12 rather than substituting a familiar spell's smaller die, both affected roll categories, and additional targets.

source: 你的肉体和衣服变得苍白且褪色，因为你的身体上呈现出一小块影域的碎片。在此法术的持续时间内，你对暗影腐化Shadow Corruption状态免疫，并对暗蚀伤害具有抗性。此外，对于降低你的力量或生命值上限的效果，如幽影Shadow的汲取力量或法术重伤术Harm ，你的豁免也具有优势。
target: Your flesh and clothing grow pale and faded as a fragment of the Shadow Realm manifests on your body. For the duration, you are immune to the Shadow Corruption condition and have Resistance to Necrotic damage. In addition, you have Advantage on saving throws against effects that reduce your Strength or Hit Point maximum, such as a Shadow's Strength Drain or the Harm spell.
note: Preserved the named Shadow Corruption condition, Necrotic Resistance, both reduction categories, and both examples without adding saves to effects that lack them.

source:
你选择的施法距离内一生物，其必须进行一次魅力豁免。豁免失败时，目标在所有魅力检定上都具有劣势，与之交谈的人在法术持续时间内对其漠不关心。如果目标在此法术效应下成功通过一次魅力检定，则可以进行一次新的魅力豁免以克服该效果。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比二环高一环，便可额外指定一名目标。
target:
Choose a creature within range. It must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on all Charisma checks, and those who speak with it are indifferent toward it for the duration. If the target succeeds on a Charisma check while under the spell's effect, it can make a new Charisma saving throw to overcome the effect.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the successful-check trigger for a new saving throw rather than adding periodic saves, plus the attitude effect and scaling.

source:
你召唤一群灵体小帮手，持续至法术结束。小帮手们看起来像是人工生命体或是其它由你选择的构装，但其不具备实体，亦无法被伤害。小帮手们视为具有对奥秘技能以及用来施展该法术的那套工匠工具的熟练项。
若你正在制造一件物品，这些灵体小帮手整体可被视为一名协助者，减半你制作这件物品的时间。
context: column:M;spell:Deryan's Helpful Homunculi;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:2
target:
You summon a group of spectral helpers that lasts until the spell ends. The helpers look like homunculi or other Constructs of your choice, but they are incorporeal and cannot be harmed. They are considered proficient in Arcana and in the set of Artisan's Tools used to cast this spell.
If you are crafting an item, the spectral helpers collectively count as one assistant, halving the time you need to craft that item.
note: Preserved the group counting as one assistant, both proficiency sources, incorporeal invulnerability, and the crafting-time benefit.

source:
你在施法距离内一处未占据空间里召唤出一个特别的人工生命体。该生物使用人工生命仆从Homunculus Servant的数据。如果你已经从这个法术拥有了一个人工生命体，该人工生命体将会被新的取代。你决定人工生命体的外观，比如一只机械鸟，带翅膀的小瓶子，或微型的活化坩埚。
战斗Combat。人工生命体对你和你的盟友来说是一位盟友。在战斗中，它使用你的先攻值，在你的回合结束后立即执行它的回合。它服从于你的命令（无需消耗你的动作）。如果你未发配命令，它会采取回避动作，并使用移动力避免危险。
升环施法。 在其数据的法术环阶中使用法术位的环阶。

人工生命仆从Homunculus Servant
微型构装，中立
AC 13 
HP 5+每法术环阶5（仆从具有等于法术环阶熟练的生命骰[d4]） 
速度 20尺，飞行30尺 
  调整 豁免    调整 豁免    调整 豁免 
力量 4 -3 -3  敏捷 15 +2 +2  体质 12 +1 +1 
智力 10 +0 +0  感知 10 +0 +0  魅力 7 -2 -2 
免疫 毒素；力竭，中毒 
感官 黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10 
语言 心灵感应1里（只与你起效） 
CR 无（XP 0；PB等于你的熟练加值） 

特质Traits
反射闪避Evasion。当人工生命体受到一个允许其进行敏捷豁免来只承受一半伤害的效应影响时，其豁免成功时不受伤害，豁免失败时只承受一半伤害。其无法在失能期间使用此特性。 
魔法连结Magic Bond。 将你的熟练加值加入人工生命体进行的任何属性检定与豁免检定。

动作Actions
力场打击Force Strike。 近战或远程攻击检定：加值等于你的法术攻击加值，触及5尺或射程30尺。命中：1d6外加法术环阶的力场伤害。

反应Reactions
传递法术Channel Magic。 触发：人工生命体位于你120尺内期间，你施展了一道施法距离为触碰的法术。 响应： 人工生命体通过其触碰传递法术
target:
You summon a special homunculus in an unoccupied space within range. It uses the Homunculus Servant stat block. If you already have a homunculus from this spell, the new one replaces it. You determine its appearance, such as a mechanical bird, a winged vial, or a tiny animated cauldron.
Combat. The homunculus is an ally of you and your allies. In combat, it uses your Initiative and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands, which require no action from you. If you give no commands, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
At Higher Levels. Use the spell slot's level wherever the stat block refers to the spell's level.

Homunculus Servant
Tiny Construct, Neutral
AC 13
HP 5 + 5 per spell level (the servant has a number of Hit Point Dice [d4] equal to the spell's level)
Speed 20 feet, Fly 30 feet
Ability | Score | Modifier | Save
Strength | 4 | −3 | −3
Dexterity | 15 | +2 | +2
Constitution | 12 | +1 | +1
Intelligence | 10 | +0 | +0
Wisdom | 10 | +0 | +0
Charisma | 7 | −2 | −2
Immunities Poison; Exhaustion, Poisoned
Senses Darkvision 60 feet, Passive Perception 10
Languages Telepathy 1 li (only with you)
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits
Evasion. When the homunculus is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, it takes no damage on a successful save and only half damage on a failed one. It cannot use this trait while Incapacitated.
Magic Bond. Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the homunculus makes.

Actions
Force Strike. Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack bonus, reach 5 feet or range 30 feet. Hit: 1d6 + the spell's level in Force damage.

Reactions
Channel Magic. Trigger: While the homunculus is within 120 feet of you, you cast a spell with a range of Touch. Response: The homunculus delivers the spell through its touch.
note: Retained the entire stat block, six ability triples, Evasion exception, Magic Bond, attack, and Reaction trigger. Bare li stays li pending unit verification. The source has a malformed word in the Hit Point Dice count; it is read as a count equal to spell level, not proficiency.

source:
在施法距离内指定一具中型或小型类人生物遗骨或遗体。目标将变为一名亡灵生物：遗骨变为骷髅skeleton，遗体则变为丧尸zombie。（这些生物的资料卡见附录B）。
在你的每个回合内，你可以使用一个附赠动作并以精神命令操纵距离你 60 尺内，任何你用此法术制造的生物（如果你操纵多个生物，则你的命令可以同时传达给它们全部或是其中的某几个，不过每次只能为它们下达同一命令）。你决定被操纵生物下回合执行的动作和如何移动。或者，你也可以选择下达一条宽泛的命令（比如守护某个房间或走廊）。如果你没有下达命令，该生物将执行回避动作且只会为躲避危险而移动。一旦被下达命令，该生物会持续执行命令直到任务完成。
这些受操纵生物只会在 24 小时内服从你的命令，在之后，它们会停止遵守你下达的命令。若你想将对这些生物的控制时间再延长24小时，则你必须在当前24小时的时间段终止前再次对这些生物施展该法术。法术的此种用法只能延长你对至多四个你使用此法术所创造生物的控制时间，而不会创造新的生物。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，你就能多唤起两只亡灵生物，或是多延长对两只亡灵生物的控制。你无法用同一具骸骨或遗体唤起多个亡灵生物。
target:
Choose the bones or corpse of a Medium or Small Humanoid within range. The target becomes an Undead creature: bones become a Skeleton, and a corpse becomes a Zombie. These creatures' stat blocks appear in appendix B.
On each of your turns, you can use a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you created with this spell that is within 60 feet of you. If you control multiple creatures, you can command all or some of them at once, but must give them the same command. You decide what action the commanded creature takes and how it moves on its next turn. Alternatively, you can give a general command, such as guarding a room or corridor. If you give no command, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid danger. Once given an order, it continues following it until its task is complete.
The creatures obey your commands for only 24 hours, after which they stop following your orders. To extend your control for another 24 hours, you must cast the spell on them again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use extends control over up to four creatures you created with the spell instead of creating a new creature.
At Higher Levels: You can animate two additional Undead or reassert control over two additional Undead for each spell slot level above level three. You cannot animate multiple Undead from the same set of bones or corpse.
note: Preserved command range, group-command restrictions, default Dodge behavior, all control-renewal timing, and the separate animation/renewal use with corpse uniqueness.

source:
你触碰一名生物。该生物必须进行一次感知豁免并成功通过，否则将在法术持续时间内被诅咒。直到诅咒终止前，目标会遭受以下一项效应，由你选择：
　　• 选择一项属性。目标使用该属性所进行的属性检定和豁免检定具有劣势。
　　• 目标对你发动的攻击检定具有劣势。
　　• 在战斗中，目标在其每回合开始时必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则在该回合中被迫执行回避动作。
　　• 若你的攻击检定或法术对目标造成了伤害，则目标还会额外受到1d8黯蚀伤害。
升环施法：使用四环法术位施展此法术时，你可以维持此法术的专注至多10分钟。使用五环及更高环阶的法术位施展此法术时，此法术无需专注，并且持续时间变为8小时（5~6环法术位）或24小时（7~8环法术位）。若你使用9环法术位施展此法术，则此法术会一直持续到被解除为止。
target:
You touch a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for the duration. Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice:
• Choose an ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws using it.
• The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
• In combat, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a failed save, it is forced to take the Dodge action that turn.
• If your attack roll or spell damages the target, it takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.
At Higher Levels: Using a level-four spell slot lets you maintain Concentration on the spell for up to 10 minutes. Using a spell slot of level five or higher removes the Concentration requirement and changes the duration to 8 hours for level 5–6 slots or 24 hours for level 7–8 slots. Using a level 9 slot makes the spell last until dispelled.
note: Preserved all four options, the 2024 forced Dodge result, and every duration/Concentration tier.

source:
被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到3d8点光耀伤害，并且目标陷入目盲状态直至法术结束。陷入目盲的目标在其每回合结束时可以进行一次体质豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上的法术。
升环施法：你使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的额外伤害提升1d8。
target:
The target hit by this attack roll takes an extra 3d8 Radiant damage from the attack and is Blinded until the spell ends. The Blinded target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels: The spell's extra damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level three.
note: Preserved immediate blindness without an initial save and subsequent end-of-turn Constitution saves.

source:
你在法术持续时间内每次自己回合结束时掷一次d6。结果为4~6时，你从你现在身处的存在位面消失，并出现在以太位面Ethereal Plane （若你本已身处以太位面，此法术会立即终止）。在你身处以太位面期间，你可以观测到你所离开位面的黑白影像，但只限于60尺之内。你只能影响其他身处以太位面的生物，或被其影响。并且处于其他位面的生物在没有能够观测到以太位面事物的特殊能力的情况下，同样无法观测到你。
你会在你的下一回合开始时返回其他位面；如果当你法术终止时身处以太位面，你同样会返回其他位面。你返回原先位面时会出现在一个你原先位置10尺之内你可见的未被占据的空间之中。若在此范围内没有未被占据的空间，则你会出现在最近的未被占据的空间之中。
target:
At the end of each of your turns for the duration, roll a d6. On a result of 4–6, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear on the Ethereal Plane; if you are already on the Ethereal Plane, the spell ends immediately. While there, you can see a black-and-white image of the plane you left, but only out to 60 feet. You can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane. Creatures on other planes cannot perceive you without a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane.
You return to the other plane at the start of your next turn, or when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane. When returning to your original plane, you appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of your former position. If no unoccupied space exists within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space.
note: Preserved d6 with 4–6, both return timings, 60-foot monochrome view, cross-plane interaction restriction, and fallback return position.

source:
一朵风暴云在施法距离内你上方可见的一点出现。风暴云表现为高10尺、半径60尺的柱状形状。
当你施展这道法术时，选择风暴云下方你可见的一点。一束闪电从云端射向该点。位于该点5尺内的生物进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者受到3d10闪电伤害，豁免成功则仅受半数伤害。
直至法术结束前，你都可以执行一个魔法动作以此法再次降下闪电，并指定闪电射向同一点或另选一点。
若施法时你身处暴风雨环境下的室外，则该法术令你得以控制空中的风暴而非创造一朵新的风暴云。在这种状况下，法术伤害增加1d10。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加 1d10。
target:
A storm cloud appears at a point you can see above you within range, taking the shape of a Cylinder 10 feet high with a radius of 60 feet.
When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see beneath the cloud. A bolt of lightning strikes that point from the cloud. Creatures within 5 feet of the point make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Until the spell ends, you can use a Magic action to call down lightning in this way again, targeting the same point or a different one.
If you are outdoors in a storm when you cast the spell, it gives you control over that storm instead of creating a new cloud. In that case, the spell's damage increases by 1d10.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above level three.
note: Preserved cloud geometry, visible points, Magic-action repeat strikes, outdoor existing-storm damage bonus, and slot scaling.

source:
你在施法距离内某处创造一个隐形的传感器，该处可以是你熟悉的地点（你曾到访过或看见过的地方），也可以是你不熟悉的显眼处（比如一扇门后，拐角位置或树林里）。这一无形体且不受伤害的传感器会在法术持续期间停留在该地。
施展该法术时，你可以选择进行观察或是聆听。你可以通过传感器以所选的感官方式感测，如同你处在传感器所在的空间。你能够以一个附赠动作在观察和聆听之间切换。
可以看见传感器的生物（例如一名生物受益于识破隐形See Invisibility或真实视觉 时）会看到传感器是一个拳头大小的发光球体。
target:
You create an Invisible sensor at a location within range. The location can be familiar to you, such as somewhere you have visited or seen, or an obvious unfamiliar place, such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees. The intangible sensor cannot be damaged and stays there for the duration.
When you cast the spell, choose sight or hearing. You perceive through the sensor with the chosen sense as though you were in its space. You can use a Bonus Action to switch between seeing and hearing.
A creature that can see the sensor, such as one benefiting from See Invisibility or Truesight, sees it as a glowing orb the size of a fist.
note: Preserved all location examples, stationary/invulnerable sensor, one-sense choice and switching cost, and its appearance to special sight.

source:
你将自然精魂咒唤在施法距离内一处你可见的未占据空间中，他们以幽灵般虚幻兽群的形象出现（占据大型空间）。兽群在持续时间内一直存在，并且你可以选择动物精魂的形态——例如狼群、蛇群或是鸟群。
　　• 在你位于兽群5尺内期间，你的力量豁免检定具有优势。当你在你的回合移动时，你可以令兽群也移动至多30尺到一处你可见的未被占据的空间中。
　　• 每当兽群在移动中进入了一名你可见的生物10尺内时、一名你可见的生物进入位于兽群10尺内的空间或是在该空间结束其回合时，你都可以迫使该生物进行一次敏捷豁免检定。失败则该生物受到3d10挥砍伤害。一名生物一回合只需要进行一次该豁免。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d10。
target:
You conjure nature spirits in an unoccupied space you can see within range. They appear as a ghostly pack of animals occupying a Large space and remain for the duration. You choose the spirits' form, such as wolves, snakes, or birds.
• While you are within 5 feet of the pack, you have Advantage on Strength saving throws. When you move on your turn, you can also move the pack up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
• Whenever the moving pack comes within 10 feet of a creature you can see, or a creature you can see enters a space within 10 feet of the pack or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d10 Slashing damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above level three.
note: Preserved the 2024 spectral-pack behavior, caster proximity benefit, movement tied to the caster's turn, all three damage triggers, optional targeting, and once-per-turn save limit.

source:
你挥舞作为施法材料的武器，令无数外形相似的灵体武器（或是适合这把武器的弹药）显现，它们将向前射出并在之后消失。每名由你选择且你可见的位于60尺锥形区域内的生物进行一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败者将受到5d8点力场伤害，豁免成功则只受一半伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d8。
target:
You brandish the weapon used as the Material component, causing countless similar spectral weapons, or ammunition suitable for that weapon, to appear, shoot forward, and vanish. Each creature you choose that you can see in a 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level three.
note: Preserved visible chosen targets rather than all creatures, spectral weapon/ammunition alternatives, and Force damage.

source: 你在施法距离内的地面上或容器中创造45磅食物和30加仑淡水，该法术创造的食物和水均可用于避免饥饿和脱水 的危害。食物味道寡淡却营养丰富，并且看起来像一种你选择的食物，水也是干净的。食物24小时内未被食用即会变坏。
context: column:M;spell:Create Food and Water;book:玩家手册;level:3
target: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water on the ground or in containers within range. Both can prevent the harmful effects of starvation and dehydration. The food is bland but nourishing and looks like a kind of food you choose; the water is clean. Food not eaten within 24 hours spoils.
note: Preserved both quantities, appearance choice, food spoilage only, and the starvation/dehydration purpose without adding an unsupported feeding-capacity count.

source:
法术持续时间内，日光从施法距离内一点发散而出，充斥一个60尺半径的球状区域。日光区域视为明亮光照，且会再额外散发出60尺微光光照。
或者，你可以将此法术施展于一个未被着装或携带的物件上，使日光充斥以该物件为中心的60尺光环区域。将该物件用不透明的东西遮掩（比如用碗或头盔盖住）时，会将日光隔绝。
如果法术区域与任何三环或更低环阶法术创造的黑暗 区域重叠，则这些造暗的法术将被解除。
target:
For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range to fill a Sphere with a radius of 60 feet. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.
Alternatively, you can cast the spell on an object that is neither worn nor carried, causing sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation centered on it. Covering the object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helmet, blocks the sunlight.
If the spell's area overlaps Darkness created by any spell of level three or lower, the spells creating that Darkness are dispelled.
note: Preserved actual sunlight, both point/object area options, the covering rule, and dispelling of qualifying Darkness spells.

source:
在施法距离内指定一名生物、一个物件或一处魔法效应。所有影响该目标的三环或更低环阶法术即告终止。每个影响目标的四环或更高环阶法术都需要以你的施法属性进行一次属性检定（DC 10+目标法术环阶），检定成功时目标法术终止。
升环施法：你直接终止影响目标的小于等于该施法环阶的法术效应。
target:
Choose a creature, object, or magical effect within range. Every spell of level three or lower affecting the target ends. For each spell of level four or higher affecting it, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability against DC 10 + that spell's level. On a success, that spell ends.
At Higher Levels: You automatically end spells affecting the target whose levels are no higher than the level at which you cast this spell.
note: Preserved a separate check for each higher-level spell and automatic ending at or below the cast level; no blanket removal of non-spell magical effects was added.

source:
你触碰的一把非魔法武器变成魔法武器。选择下述伤害类型之一：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、雷鸣。法术持续时间内，用那把武器发动的攻击检定具有+1加值，且在命中时造成额外1d4点你所选伤害类型的伤害。
升环施法：使用五环或六环法术位时，攻击检定的加值变为+2，额外伤害变为2d4。使用七环或更高法术位时，攻击检定的加值变为+3，额外伤害变为3d4。
target:
A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. For the duration, attack rolls with the weapon gain a +1 bonus, and a hit deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type.
At Higher Levels: Using a spell slot of level five or six changes the attack-roll bonus to +2 and the extra damage to 2d4. Using a slot of level seven or higher changes the attack-roll bonus to +3 and the extra damage to 3d4.
note: Preserved all five damage choices, attack-only numeric bonus, extra damage dice, and both higher-level bands.

source:
30尺锥状区域内的所有生物必须通过一次感知豁免，豁免失败者将丢弃其所有持握物，并在法术持续时间内陷入恐慌状态。
以此法被恐慌的生物必须在自己回合中执行疾走动作，并以此寻找最安全的路线远离你，直至其无路可走为止。如果该生物结束其回合时位于一处使其视觉线中没有你的空间，则其可以再进行一次感知豁免，豁免成功则法术对该生物的效应终止。
target:
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop everything it is holding and be Frightened for the duration.
A creature Frightened in this way must take the Dash action on its turns and move away from you by the safest available route until it has nowhere to go. If it ends its turn in a space where it does not have you in its line of sight, it can make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
note: Preserved dropped held items, mandatory Dash and safest route, and the line-of-sight condition for another save.

source:
你触碰一名自愿生物并将其变得如死者般的僵直。
在法术持续时间内，对目标进行的任何肉体检查和法术检测都显示目标已死亡。该状况下的目标陷入目盲以及失能状态，且其速度降至0。
目标对除了心灵伤害外的所有伤害类型具有抗性，也免疫中毒状态。
target:
You touch a willing creature and make it rigid like a corpse.
For the duration, all physical examinations and spell-based detections indicate that the target is dead. It is Blinded and Incapacitated, and its Speed is reduced to 0.
The target has Resistance to all damage types except Psychic and is immune to the Poisoned condition.
note: Preserved the exact conditions, zero Speed, Psychic exception, and Poisoned immunity without substituting older disease/poison-suppression wording.

source:
明亮的闪光从你的指间飞驰向施法距离内你指定的一点，并随着一声低吼迸成一片烈焰。目标点周围半径20尺球状区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到8d6点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
区域内所有未被着装或携带的可燃物件会开始燃烧。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，此伤害就增加1d6。
target:
A bright streak flashes from your finger to a point you choose within range, then blossoms into flame with a low roar. Each creature in a Sphere with a radius of 20 feet centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
All flammable objects in the area that are neither worn nor carried begin to burn.
At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level three.
note: Preserved the complete casting description, radius, both save results, and unattended-object ignition.

source:
你触碰一个自愿生物。目标在法术持续时间内获得60尺的飞行速度且可以悬浮。法术终止时，如果目标仍在空中，否则其随即坠落，除非其有办法阻止坠落。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，你就可以额外再指定一名生物作为法术目标。
target:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, it gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, a target still in the air falls unless it has a way to prevent the fall.
At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level three.
note: The source contains a stray otherwise inside its falling condition; the translation follows the stated still-airborne condition and unless exception. Hover and target scaling are retained.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你将触碰到的一名自愿生物连同其穿着携带物一起转化为一团云雾。如果目标的生命值降至0或其用一个魔法动作终止其身上的法术效应，则该目标身上的法术终止。
在该形态下，目标唯一的移动方式即是10尺的飞行速度，且可以悬浮。该目标可以进入并占据一个已有生物占据的空间。其拥有钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害的抗性，其对倒地状态免疫，且进行的力量、敏捷、体质豁免具有优势。该目标可以穿过狭隙，但会将液态物质视为固体表面。
云雾形态的目标不能讲话或操作物件，其随身携带或持握的物件不会掉落，也不能被使用或与之互动。另外，目标也不能攻击或施法。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比三环高一环，你就可以额外再指定一名生物作为法术目标。
target:
For the duration, you transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it wears and carries, into a cloud of mist. The spell ends on a target if it drops to 0 Hit Points or uses a Magic action to end the effect on itself.
In this form, the target's only movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. It can enter and occupy a space already occupied by a creature. It has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, is immune to the Prone condition, and has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. It can pass through narrow gaps but treats liquids as solid surfaces.
The mist-form target cannot speak or manipulate objects. Objects it carries or holds do not fall, but cannot be used or interacted with. It also cannot attack or cast spells.
At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level three.
